name: biz-mindmap
title: Business Mind Map
description: A central topic radiating into 2–6 branches, each revealed with its points as the narration reaches it.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: AI may rewrite every content variable within its limits, choose the skin and camera, and bind measured cue times. Colours and fonts always come from the active --ipw-* theme.

variables.label: Branches (label@icon::point, point | ...)
variables.default: 教@cap::备课助手,课件生成,分层教学|学@book::个性化路径,苏格拉底式答疑,错题本,口语陪练|评@check::自动批改,能力画像,过程性评价|管@chart::学情看板,资源调度

variables.label: Visual skin
variables.description: Visual language only; colors and fonts always come from the active --ipw-* theme.

variables.label: Camera
variables.description: Camera move with enter, hold drift and exit phases on the composition timeline.

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses content-paced defaults; this is not word alignment.

usage.intent: 围绕一个主题向外发散，按旁白逐支展开，让观众看到全貌而不是一次性信息轰炸。
useWhen: Explore one topic through 2–6 associated themes with a few short points each.
avoidWhen: Do not use for reporting lines, ordered steps or dependencies; branch position and length carry no quantity.

inputRules.center: The real topic in at most 12 CJK characters; optional @icon suffix.
inputRules.branches: 2–6 entries separated by "|": label@icon::point, point. Labels ≤ 8 CJK characters, 0–5 points of ≤ 10 CJK characters each.
inputRules.highlight: 1-based branch index to emphasise, or 0 for none.
inputRules.reveal: branch for narrated walkthroughs, level for overviews, all for a static map.
inputRules.centerSub: Optional short subtitle under the topic, ≤ 32 characters; Latin text renders as small caps.
inputRules.skin: keynote for calm launches, cinematic for dark stages, editorial for print-like explainers, dot for hardware/AI moods; colours still follow --ipw-*.
inputRules.camera: flat by default; tilt, iso, unfold or dolly only when depth helps the story. The camera enters, drifts while held and exits with the scene.

readingOrder: Follow each branch and its points

cueBindings.center: When narration names the topic, establish the centre.
cueBindings.step-1: When narration reaches branch 1, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.step-2: When narration reaches branch 2, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.step-3: When narration reaches branch 3, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.step-4: When narration reaches branch 4, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.step-5: When narration reaches branch 5, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.step-6: When narration reaches branch 6, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding clause, restore the whole map; keep the final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or choose a sparser business diagram; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once in order; keep authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary instead of stretching speech.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another business diagram or registry recipe whose structure matches the content, split the content, or report the gap.

values.branches: 教@cap::备课助手,课件生成|学@book::个性化路径,错题本|评@check::自动批改,能力画像

example.narration: AI 进入教育后，首先改变的是教，其次是学，最后是评。

Inactive capacity slots acquire no cue and render nothing.
